queryMethod.resolve: Use query/index.json to resolve a path to one or more link files.
queryMethod.combine: Fetch any number of link files and sum their daily values.
queryMethod.dateRange: Sum only days whose YYYY-MM-DD key falls inside the requested inclusive range.
queryMethod.creationDate: Use createdAt to determine when a link actually existed.
queryMethod.allTime: Use totalClicks when the full archived lifetime is requested.
